title: Past and storytelling
function: Tell what you did yesterday or last weekend

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn the Past Simple tense to talk about finished actions in the past. You will see regular verbs (played) and irregular verbs (went, saw).

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. Yesterday I visited my grandmother. Last summer we went to Italy. She saw a beautiful sunset. Notice how regular verbs end in -ed and irregular verbs change completely.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: Last weekend we ___ to the beach.
phases.explanation: Go is irregular. Its Past Simple form is went.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 sentences about what you did last weekend.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.explanation: With regular verbs we add -ed in Past Simple.
